technical-summary: Added a strict offline JSONL validator/loader for transform-attempt and transform-gap records. It requires source signatures, hardware/build provenance, transformation identity, outcome/reason fields, and case-insensitively unique evidence references; runtime transforms, SQLite, and replay wire formats are unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Added the bounded HI29/HI33 offline transform-record schema and loader with focused malformed-input and provenance regressions.
